extensionDescription.message: Zero-server, end-to-end encrypted real-time SMS & OTP notifications synced from your Android phone with 1-click clipboard copy.
extensionDescription.description: The extension's description in the browser's extension list and store.

statusLinked.description: Header badge when one phone is linked.

statusLinkedCount_one.description: Header badge when several phones are linked.

statusLinkedCount_other.description: Header badge when several phones are linked.

statusNotLinked.description: Header badge when no phone is linked.

pairButton.description: Header button that shows the pairing QR code.

pairAnotherButton.description: Header button that shows the pairing QR code once a phone is linked.

pairAnotherButtonTitle.message: Show QR code to link an additional phone
pairAnotherButtonTitle.description: Tooltip of the Pair Another button.

moreOptions.description: Name of the menu button in the header.

unlinkAllPhones.description: Menu item that unlinks every phone.

clearMessages.description: Menu item, and its dialog's button, that removes the stored messages.

phoneFallbackName.description: Name of a phone that sent none.

bannerLinked.description: After the phone's name in the banner, when one phone is linked.

bannerLinkedCount_one.description: After the phones' names in the banner.

bannerLinkedCount_other.description: After the phones' names in the banner.

active.description: Says a linked phone is active, when its last activity is unknown.

linkedPhones.description: Name of the list of linked phones.

lastActive.description: When a linked phone last sent something.

unlink.description: Button that unlinks one phone, and its dialog's button.

unlinkPhone.description: Name of the Unlink button of one phone, for screen readers.

unlinkPhoneTitle.description: Title of the dialog that unlinks one phone.

unlinkPhoneText.message: Messages from $NAME$ will be ignored here. To stop it sending them, also unlink this computer in the SMS app on that phone.
unlinkPhoneText.description: Text of the dialog that unlinks one phone.

phoneUnlinked.description: Status after one phone is unlinked.

pairHeading.description: Heading of the pairing QR code card.

pairOpenApp.message: Open HMJ SMS app on phone
pairOpenApp.description: First step of pairing, before the app's menu path. Keep the app's name, HMJ SMS, in English.

pairAppPath.message: Settings → Desktop Sync → Scan QR Code
pairAppPath.description: Where to go in the HMJ SMS app to scan the QR code. Use the app's own labels.

pairingQrCode.description: Name of the QR code image, for screen readers.

copyCode.description: Button that copies the pairing code.

hide.description: Button that hides the pairing QR code.

pairingWarning.message: This code holds the keys to your link. Show or paste it only on your own phone, and keep it away from clipboard sync and screen sharing.
pairingWarning.description: Warning under the pairing QR code.

pairingChanged.message: Your pairing changed. Scan the QR code again on each phone.
pairingChanged.description: Banner when the browser ended the push address the phones send to, so every phone must pair again.

notificationsOff.message: Notifications are turned off for this extension in the browser, so messages are stored but not shown.
notificationsOff.description: Banner when the browser blocks this extension's notifications.

emptyTitle.description: Title of the empty message list when no phone is linked.

emptyText.message: Incoming SMS and OTPs will appear here in real-time.
emptyText.description: Text of the empty message list when no phone is linked.

showPairingQrCode.description: Button in the empty message list that shows the pairing QR code.

connectedTo.description: Title of the empty message list when one phone is linked.

connectedToCount_one.description: Title of the empty message list when several phones are linked.

connectedToCount_other.description: Title of the empty message list when several phones are linked.

waitingFor.message: Waiting for incoming SMS & OTP alerts from $NAMES$.
waitingFor.description: Text of the empty message list when phones are linked.

cancel.description: Dialog button that closes it without doing anything.

copied.description: A copy button's label for a moment after it copied.

pairingCodeCopied.description: Said to screen readers after the pairing code is copied.

otpCopied.description: Said to screen readers after an OTP is copied.

messageCopied.description: Said to screen readers after a message is copied.

noAnswer.description: Error when the extension's background did not answer.

unlinkAllTitle.description: Title of the Unlink All Phones dialog.

unlinkAllText.message: This computer gets a new pairing code, and no phone can reach it any more. Every message stored in this extension is removed. Phones you keep must scan the new QR code.
unlinkAllText.description: Text of the Unlink All Phones dialog.

unlinkAllAction.description: Button of the Unlink All Phones dialog.

allPhonesUnlinked.message: All phones unlinked and messages cleared. Scan the new QR code to pair again.

clearTitle.description: Title of the Clear Messages dialog.

clearText.message: Every message stored in this extension will be removed. Messages on your phone are not affected.
clearText.description: Text of the Clear Messages dialog.

clearFailed.description: Status when clearing the messages fails.

pairingCodeFailed.message: Could not make a pairing code: $ERROR$
pairingCodeFailed.description: When the pairing code cannot be made.

error.example: This browser cannot receive push messages.

newMessageFrom.description: Said to screen readers when a message arrives while the popup is open.

unknownSender.description: Sender of a message that names none.

simWithName.description: Which SIM a message came to, with the SIM's name.

sim.description: Which SIM a message came to.

groupWith.description: The other members of a group message.

copyOtp.description: Button, and notification button, that copies a message's OTP.

copyMessage.description: Notification button that copies the message.

justNow.description: How long ago something happened: under a minute.

groupNamesMore.description: The group members named, and how many more there are.

photo.description: One photo attached to an MMS.

video.description: One video attached to an MMS.

audio.description: One audio clip attached to an MMS.

audioClips_one.description: Audio clips attached to an MMS.

audioClips_other.description: Audio clips attached to an MMS.

contact.description: One contact attached to an MMS.

file.description: One file attached to an MMS.

groupTitle.description: Notification title of a group message.

unreadableMessage.description: Text of a message the extension could not read.

linkVerified.message: Link verified with $NAME$! Instant SMS alerts are active.
linkVerified.description: Test message when a phone pairs, if the phone sent no text of its own.

expiredOtpBadge.description: Before the title of a notification whose OTP arrived too late to use.

simBadge.description: Before a notification's title: the SIM the message came to.

deliveredLate.description: Text of a notification whose OTP arrived too late to use.

phoneUnlinkedTitle.description: Title of the notice about messages from an unlinked phone.

aPhone.description: An unlinked phone without a name, in the notice about its messages.

ignoredMessages_one.message: $COUNT$ message ignored. Unlink this computer in the SMS app on that phone to stop them, or click here to unlink all phones.
ignoredMessages_one.description: Text of the notice about messages from an unlinked phone.

ignoredMessages_other.message: $COUNT$ messages ignored. Unlink this computer in the SMS app on that phone to stop them, or click here to unlink all phones.
ignoredMessages_other.description: Text of the notice about messages from an unlinked phone.

pairingCodeTooLong.message: The pairing code is too long for the phone to read.
pairingCodeTooLong.description: Error when the pairing code is longer than the phone accepts.

noPhoneToUnlink.description: Error when unlinking names no phone.

noPushService.message: This browser cannot receive push messages.
noPushService.description: Error when the browser has no push service.
